recipe.variant: FLUX.2 [dev] 32B fp8-mixed via UNETLoader + CLIPLoader(flux2, Mistral-3 24B bf16) + small-decoder VAE; BasicGuider + FluxGuidance 4, Flux2Scheduler 20 steps, euler — the official template with the Turbo switch off

width.note: EmptyFlux2LatentImage and Flux2Scheduler must get the same value: the sigmas depend on (width*height)/256

sampler.note: the sampling method (ComfyUI's sampler list: euler, dpmpp_2m, res_multistep, …)

recipe.defaults_note: 1024x1024, 20 steps (BFL: 50, '28 steps can be a good trade-off'), FluxGuidance 4 (BFL guidance_scale=4), euler, no negative (guidance-distilled: BasicGuider). Text encoder bf16 35.6 GB: swap to mistral_3_small_flux2_fp8.safetensors (18 GB) or set CLIPLoader.device = cpu on a 24 GB card.

vram_evidence.gpu: 24 GB with offload (fp8); 15 GB per ComfyUI
vram_evidence.note: ComfyUI (X, 2025-11-25): 'FLUX.2 Dev FP8 from NVIDIA ... reducing the VRAM requirements by 50% down to 15GB'; blog: FP8 'reduces requirements by 40%'; community: fits a 24 GB card with offload, '24GB+ strongly recommended for high-resolution work', 64-96 GB system RAM reported. The 35.6 GB bf16 Mistral encoder is the other half of the budget: CLIPLoader.device = cpu or the fp8/fp4 encoder.
